methodologyNotes: Roster of 12 current/recent 18-gauge brad nailers spanning cordless (20V/18V battery-platform) and pneumatic designs from DeWalt, Milwaukee, Ryobi, Makita, Metabo HPT, Bostitch, Senco, Porter-Cable, Craftsman, WEN, and RIDGID — framing nailers and staplers excluded. brad_length_range_in is a min-max string in inches; weight_lb and magazine_capacity are bare numbers; depth_adjustment / dual_firing_mode / tool_free_jam_release are booleans (feature tool-free/selectable as explicitly advertised by the cited source) — null wherever no source explicitly confirmed the feature. priceUsd is the most defensible current U.S. figure found; null wherever no published USD price could be confirmed this pass. Release dates left null (no dated manufacturer announcement confirmed). ADVERSARIAL RE-VERIFICATION PASS (accessedAt 2026-08-16): manufacturer pages re-fetched and confirmed for DeWalt, Milwaukee, Makita, both Metabo HPT models, Senco, WEN, Ryobi, and RIDGID (via authorized reseller). Prices confirmed live: Milwaukee $329 (ToolNut), Makita $339 (The Power Tool Store), Senco $125.35 list (JMP Wood), WEN $31.99 (wenproducts.com), Ryobi P321K1 kit $229 (ryobitools.com). DeWalt $349 and Metabo NT50AE2 $99 retained as manufacturer MSRP (live retailer prices not fetchable — Home Depot/Ace/Zoro/Walmart/Menards block automated access). Prices set to null where the only cited listing was inaccessible AND the drafted figure looked inflated (Bostitch, Porter-Cable, Craftsman) or the SKU is discontinued (RIDGID). Corrections: NT1850DES renamed from 'MultiVolt' to straight 18V (per mfr page); RIDGID weight corrected 5.8->7.71 lb (per DPCI authorized reseller); several unverifiable specs nulled per null-beats-a-guess.

products.name: DeWalt 20V MAX XR Cordless 18 Gauge Brad Nailer (DCN680B)

Magazine (110) and bare-tool weight (5.3 lb) are DeWalt's widely published figures but were not shown on the manufacturer page as fetched and no reachable retailer could be used to independently re-confirm them this pass.
